Verplichting.title: Verplichting
Verplichting.description: A financial commitment (verplichting) tracked from the moment it becomes legally binding (PO signed, raamovereenkomst agreed, arbeidscontract executed, subsidiebeschikking awarded) through delivery, invoicing, payment, and closure. Drives budget-blocking at commitment-time (REQ-VPL-001) and mandate enforcement on aangaan (REQ-VPL-002). The status field is the lifecycle field; every state change is recorded as an immutable Verplichtingsmutatie (D1). The tegenpartij is an embedded vendor reference (kvk/naam/iban) — not a bespoke customer schema; a customer/contact is a Nextcloud entity (ADR). THIS FRAGMENT IS THE SINGLE OWNER OF THIS SCHEMA'S `required` LIST: ADR-037's deepMergeConfig() CONCATENATES list values, so a second fragment declaring `required` makes the effective list the UNION of both and no payload of either model can satisfy it. Overlay fragments (20-bookkeeping-tenderned-integratie.json) contribute properties only.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this verplichting for tenant isolation (IDOR-safe scoping).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

verplichtingsnummer.description: Operator-assigned unique commitment number within the administration. TWO SPELLINGS OF THIS FIELD ARE LIVE IN PRODUCTION and both are declared until the naming decision lands: this one is written and read by CommitmentMaterialisationService, BudgetBlocker::canCommit, MandaatEnforcer::hasSufficientMandate and RequisitionService; the camelCase `verplichtingNummer` declared by 20-bookkeeping-tenderned-integratie.json is written by TenderNedAwardDetectedListener and read by VerplichtingGuard. Neither is in `required`, because requiring one silently rejects every write from the other path. Collapsing to one spelling is a DATA migration (OpenRegister's MagicMapper discards undeclared properties) and needs a repair step, so it is deliberately not done here.
verplichtingsnummer.title: Verplichtingsnummer

bronReferentie.description: Provenance reference for auto-materialised commitments (REQ-VPL-010): the poNumber of the approved PurchaseOrder or the contractNumber of the signed Contract this Verplichting was raised from. Used as the idempotency key so a repeated approval/signature transition never creates a duplicate commitment. Null for manually-created commitments.

looptijd_tot.description: End of the commitment term. Snapped to boekjaar boundaries for regel creation (D10).

in_goedkeuring.label: In goedkeuring

aangegaan.label: Aangegaan
aangegaan.description: Signed/legally binding. Budget is blocked; an aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie is recorded (REQ-VPL-001/003).

deels_geleverd.label: Deels geleverd
deels_geleverd.description: Goods/services partially received (prestatie_ontvangen). Informational; no budget change (REQ-VPL-003).

deels_gefactureerd.label: Deels gefactureerd
deels_gefactureerd.description: Partially invoiced; restant_verplicht reduced and AP invoice matched (REQ-VPL-003).

deels_betaald.label: Deels betaald
deels_betaald.description: Partially paid; no further budget impact (REQ-VPL-003).

afgesloten.label: Afgesloten
afgesloten.description: Closed; remaining restant released back to budget (REQ-VPL-006).

geannuleerd.label: Geannuleerd
geannuleerd.description: Cancelled; reversal mutatie posted and openstaande_verplichtingen reduced (REQ-VPL-006). Remains queryable for audit.

indienen.label: Ter goedkeuring aanbieden
indienen.description: Offer for approval when the signer's mandaat is insufficient. Gated by MandaatEnforcer (REQ-VPL-002).

aangaan.label: Verplichting aangaan
aangaan.description: Sign the commitment within mandaat and budget. Gated by MandaatEnforcer (mandaat sufficient) and BudgetBlocker (vrije_ruimte sufficient or override). An aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie is recorded (REQ-VPL-001/002).

actions.description: Record an aangegaan Verplichtingsmutatie and increase openstaande_verplichtingen on the matching budgets (REQ-VPL-001/003).

goedkeuren.label: Goedkeuren
goedkeuren.description: Approval chain completed; the commitment becomes binding. Gated by BudgetBlocker (REQ-VPL-002).

factureren.label: Factureren
factureren.description: Invoice matched against the commitment; restant_verplicht reduced (REQ-VPL-003).

betalen.label: Betalen
betalen.description: Payment settled; openstaande_verplichtingen unchanged (already released at gefactureerd, REQ-VPL-003).

afsluiten.label: Afsluiten
afsluiten.description: Close the commitment; restant released back to budget (REQ-VPL-006).

annuleren.label: Annuleren
annuleren.description: Cancel; reversal mutatie posted, openstaande_verplichtingen reduced (REQ-VPL-006).

verplichting-goedkeuring.description: Approval chain that gates the Verplichting in_goedkeuring -> aangegaan `goedkeuren` transition (REQ-VPL-013). A commitment reaches in_goedkeuring only when MandaatEnforcer::requiresApproval routed it there because the signer's mandaat was insufficient (REQ-VPL-002); this chain then runs the finance approval workflow that releases it. Threshold-routed on totaalbedrag_excl_btw (EUR cents): a single commitment-administrator approves from EUR 0, and a finance-director approves commitments at or above EUR 250.000. Separation of duties is enforced - the requester who submitted the commitment cannot approve their own step. On completion the goedkeuren transition auto-advances (BudgetBlocker still gates the budget). Declarative metadata only: OpenRegister's approval-workflow primitive (x-openregister-approval-chains, ApprovalChainGateListener/ApprovalChainAdvanceListener) materialises and gates the actual steps; this app ships no PHP approval-chain implementation. INERT until the OpenRegister release carrying the declarative approval-chains capability (PR #396/#397) is deployed - see openspec/changes/migrate-mandaat-to-approval-chains/design.md for the sequencing and the named follow-up.

regels.description: Budget-tracking line items, one per coderingscombinatie / boekjaar (D2).

mutaties.description: Immutable audit log of every state change (D1).

mandaat.description: The mandaat under whose authority the commitment was signed.

Verplichtingsregel.title: Verplichtingsregel
Verplichtingsregel.description: A budget-tracking line on a Verplichting, one per budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Each regel tracks its own delivery, invoicing, and payment independently so multi-year raamovereenkomsten block budget per boekjaar (D2, REQ-VPL-004).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

regelnummer.description: Sequential line number within the verplichting.
regelnummer.title: Regelnummer

boekjaar.description: Fiscal year this line's budget is consumed from (REQ-VPL-004).
boekjaar.title: Boekjaar

bedrag_excl_btw.description: Committed amount excluding VAT, in minor units (EUR cents).
bedrag_excl_btw.title: Bedrag Excl BTW

bedrag_incl_btw.description: Committed amount including VAT, in minor units.
bedrag_incl_btw.title: Bedrag Incl BTW

programma.description: BBV taakveld / programma code, ties the commitment to a budget bucket (REQ-VPL-009).
programma.title: Programma

btw_code.description: VAT code applied to the line.
btw_code.title: BTW Code

geleverd_bedrag.description: Aggregated received amount, in minor units (informational; no budget impact).
geleverd_bedrag.title: Geleverd Bedrag

gefactureerd_bedrag.description: Aggregated invoiced amount, in minor units.
gefactureerd_bedrag.title: Gefactureerd Bedrag

betaald_bedrag.description: Aggregated paid amount, in minor units.
betaald_bedrag.title: Betaald Bedrag

committedVsRealisedPerBudgetLine.description: REQ-VPL-011: per-budget-line committed-vs-realised rollup, grouped by budget coderingscombinatie (programma + kostenplaats + boekjaar + grootboekrekening). Excludes afgesloten regels. verplicht = sum(restant_verplicht); gerealiseerd = sum(gefactureerd_bedrag); geautoriseerd is joined from the matching Budget (administrationId + programmaCode = programma + boekjaar); vrij = geautoriseerd - verplicht - gerealiseerd is computed by the drilldown view (BudgetLineCommitments.vue) from these three declared figures — no parallel PHP reporting service (ADR-031).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Verplichtingsregel is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Verplichtingsmutatie.title: Verplichtingsmutatie
Verplichtingsmutatie.description: Immutable audit-log entry for every change to a Verplichting (D1, REQ-VPL-010). The verplichting.status is derived from the latest mutatie. Bedrag may be negative for geannuleerd/verlaagd/teruggevorderd; aggregations track sign explicitly.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

verplichtingsregel.description: Optional FK to the specific Verplichtingsregel affected.
verplichtingsregel.title: Verplichtingsregel

bedrag.description: Mutation amount in minor units (EUR cents); may be negative for verlaagd/geannuleerd/teruggevorderd.
bedrag.title: Bedrag

toelichting.description: Free-text explanation for the audit trail.
toelichting.title: Toelichting

gerelateerde_factuur.description: Optional FK to the AP/AR Invoice this mutation relates to.
gerelateerde_factuur.title: Gerelateerde Factuur

gerelateerde_betaling.description: Optional FK to the Payment/PaymentRun this mutation relates to.
gerelateerde_betaling.title: Gerelateerde Betaling

journaalpost.description: Optional FK to the GLTransaction journal entry.
journaalpost.title: Journaalpost

gebruiker.description: FK to the Nextcloud user who triggered the mutation.
gebruiker.title: Gebruiker

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Verplichtingsmutatie is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Mandaat.title: Mandaat
Mandaat.description: Authorization record defining who may sign commitments up to what amount, for which soort_verplichting, with optional second-signature thresholds (D6, REQ-VPL-002). Enforced by MandaatEnforcer on the verplichting aangaan transition. A register (not an enum) so operators can manage mandates over time.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

mandaatcode.description: Unique mandate code within the administration.
mandaatcode.title: Mandaatcode

houder.description: FK to a Nextcloud user or role that holds the mandate.
houder.title: Houder

houder_type.description: Whether houder references a user, a role, or a team.
houder_type.title: Houder Type

maximumbedrag.description: Ceiling amount this mandate may sign, in minor units (EUR cents). Use a very large value for unlimited.
maximumbedrag.title: Maximumbedrag

soort_verplichting.description: Commitment kinds this mandate applies to.
soort_verplichting.title: Soort Verplichting

is_override.description: Whether this mandate may force-accept a budget-exceeding commitment with an audit-trail reason (REQ-VPL-001).
is_override.title: Is Override

uitsluitingen.description: Optional textual exclusions narrowing the mandate.
uitsluitingen.title: Uitsluitingen

geldig_tot.description: Mandate validity end. Expired mandates are treated as absent (REQ-VPL-002).
geldig_tot.title: Geldig Tot

vastgesteld_bij.description: Legal reference under which the mandate was established (e.g. Mandaatregeling Gemeentewet 168).
vastgesteld_bij.title: Vastgesteld Bij

vereist_tweede_handtekening_boven.description: Amount above which a second signature is required, in minor units (REQ-VPL-002).
vereist_tweede_handtekening_boven.title: Vereist Tweede Handtekening Boven

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Mandaat is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Goedkeuringsstap.title: Goedkeuringsstap
Goedkeuringsstap.description: A workflow step in a commitment's approval chain when the signer's mandaat is exceeded (D7, REQ-VPL-002). Created by MandaatEnforcer when a verplichting moves to in_goedkeuring; gives finance a clear view of pending approvals.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

verplichting.description: FK to the Verplichting awaiting approval.
verplichting.title: Verplichting

stapnummer.description: Sequential step number in the approval chain.
stapnummer.title: Stapnummer

rol_vereist.description: Role required to action this step.
rol_vereist.title: Rol Vereist

toegewezen_aan.description: FK to the Nextcloud user assigned this step.
toegewezen_aan.title: Toegewezen Aan

vereist_handtekening.description: Whether this step requires a digital signature.
vereist_handtekening.title: Vereist Handtekening

handtekening_bestand.description: File URI of the captured signature.
handtekening_bestand.title: Handtekening Bestand

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Goedkeuringsstap is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Per-programma / per-boekjaar budget bucket. Verplichtingenadministratie introduces this register (no prior Budget schema exists in shillinq) so budget can be blocked at commitment-time. vrije_ruimte = geautoriseerd_bedrag - gerealiseerd_bedrag - openstaande_verplichtingen, evaluated on-demand (D4/D9, REQ-VPL-001).

administrationId.description: FK to the owning Administration (tenant isolation).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

programmaCode.description: BBV programma / taakveld code this budget covers.
programmaCode.title: Programma Code

kostenplaats.description: Optional cost-centre scope for the budget.
kostenplaats.title: Kostenplaats

geautoriseerd_bedrag.description: Authorised budget, in minor units (EUR cents).
geautoriseerd_bedrag.title: Geautoriseerd Bedrag

openstaande_verplichtingen.description: Outstanding commitments aggregated from Verplichtingsregels, in minor units (D9, REQ-VPL-001).
openstaande_verplichtingen.title: Openstaande Verplichtingen

vrije_ruimte.description: Calculated free budget = geautoriseerd_bedrag - gerealiseerd_bedrag - openstaande_verplichtingen (D9).
vrije_ruimte.title: Vrije Ruimte

openstaande_verplichtingen.description: On-demand sum of outstanding committed amounts for this programma + boekjaar; not cached (D9, REQ-VPL-001).
